sanskrit: nikṣa darbha sapatnān me nikṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ | nikṣa me sarvān durhārdo nikṣa me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Pierce, O Darbha, my rivals; pierce for me those who array armies against me; pierce for me all the malicious of heart; pierce for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: tṛndhi darbha sapatnān me tṛndhi me pṛtanāyataḥ | tṛndhi me sarvān durhārdas tṛndhi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Bore through, O Darbha, my rivals; bore through for me those who array armies against me; bore through for me all the malicious of heart; bore through for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: bhaṅdhi darbha sapatnān me bhaṅdhi me pṛtanāyataḥ | bhaṅdhi me sarvān durhārdo bhaṅdhi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Shatter, O Darbha, my rivals; shatter for me those who array armies against me; shatter for me all the malicious of heart; shatter for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: mṛṇa darbha sapatnān me mṛṇa me pṛtanāyataḥ | mṛṇa me sarvān durhārdo mṛṇa me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Crush, O Darbha, my rivals; crush for me those who array armies against me; crush for me all the malicious of heart; crush for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: mantha darbha sapatnān me mantha me pṛtanāyataḥ | mantha me sarvān durhārdo mantha me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Churn down, O Darbha, my rivals; churn down for me those who array armies against me; churn down for me all the malicious of heart; churn down for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: piṇḍhi darbha sapatnān me piṇḍhi me pṛtanāyataḥ | piṇḍhi me sarvān durhārdaḥ piṇḍhi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Compress, O Darbha, my rivals; compress for me those who array armies against me; compress for me all the malicious of heart; compress for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: oṣa darbha sapatnān me oṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ | oṣa me sarvān durhārda oṣa me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Scorch, O Darbha, my rivals; scorch for me those who array armies against me; scorch for me all the malicious of heart; scorch for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: daha darbha sapatnān me daha me pṛtanāyataḥ | daha me sarvān durhārdo daha me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Burn, O Darbha, my rivals; burn for me those who array armies against me; burn for me all the malicious of heart; burn for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: jahi darbha sapatnān me jahi me pṛtanāyataḥ | jahi me sarvān durhārdo jahi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Smite, O Darbha, my rivals; smite for me those who array armies against me; smite for me all the malicious of heart; smite for me the haters, O amulet.

sanskrit: yat te darbha jarāmṛtyū sa te marmasu varma te | tenemaṃ varmiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapatnān jahi vīryaiḥ ||
english: What in you, O Darbha, constitutes death-by-old-age — that is your armour at the vital points; having made this one armour-clad with it, smite the rivals with heroic powers.

sanskrit: śataṃ te darbha varmāṇi sahasraṃ vīryāṇi te | tam asmai viśve tvāṃ devā jarase bhartavā aduḥ ||
english: A hundred armours are yours, O Darbha, a thousand heroic powers are yours; all the gods have given you over to be borne by him unto old age.

sanskrit: tvām āhur devavarma tvāṃ darbha brahmaṇaspatim | tvām indrasyāhur varma tvaṃ rāṣṭrāṇi rakṣasi ||
english: They call you the armour of the gods; they call you, O Darbha, the lord of brahman-power; they call you the armour of Indra — you are the protector of kingdoms.

sanskrit: sapatnakṣayaṇaṃ darbhaṃ dviṣatas tapanaṃ hṛdaḥ | maṇiṃ kṣatrasya vardhanaṃ tanūpānaṃ kṛṇomi te ||
english: The Darbha that destroys rivals, that scorches the heart of the hater, the amulet that augments sovereign power — I make it a guardian of your person.

sanskrit: yat samudro abhyakrandat parjanyo vidyutā saha | tato hiraṇyayo bindus tato darbho ajāyata ||
english: When the ocean roared forth and Parjanya roared with the lightning — from that was born a golden drop, from that was born the Darbha.
